measurements.name: shader-writes-depth-into-4x-pass
measurements.why: can a fragment shader write frag_depth inside a 4-sample pass (the mechanism a resolve-free depth copy would use)?

findings.statement: a render pass MUST use one sample count for all its attachments

evidence.rejected:
Error: The depth stencil attachment [TextureView of Texture "depth-1x"] sample count (1) does not match the sample count of the other attachments (4).
 - While validating depthStencilAttachment.
 - While encoding [CommandEncoder (unlabeled)].BeginRenderPass([RenderPassDescriptor]).
 - While finishing [CommandEncoder (unlabeled)].

findings.consequence: the WebGL idiom (multisampled depth attachment + single-sampled depth texture) cannot be built as-is

findings.statement: this Chrome has no usable depth resolve: neither a pass `resolveTarget` that actually writes, nor a manual multisample depth copy

evidence.copyTextureToTexture:
Error: Source [Texture "depth-copy-src"] sample count (4) and destination [Texture "depth-copy-dst"] sample count (1) does not match.
 - While [Failed to format error message: "encoding %s.CopyTextureToTexture(%s, %s, %s)."].
 - While finishing [CommandEncoder (unlabeled)].

findings.consequence: a samplable depth texture cannot be produced from a multisampled pass on this platform

findings.statement: a fragment shader can write depth inside a multisampled pass
findings.consequence: a resolve-free depth copy (full-screen quad writing sampled depth) remains a legal design, so MSAA is not automatically lost

findings.statement: a multisampled depth texture is readable through `texture_depth_multisampled_2d` + textureLoad, so a depth resolve can be written in a shader

evidence.plainDepth2dBinding:
Error: Sample count (4) of [Texture "samplable-4x-depth"] doesn't match expectation (multisampled: 0).
 - While validating entries[0] against { binding: 0, visibility: ShaderStage::Fragment, texture: {sampleType: TextureSampleType::Depth, viewDimension: TextureViewDimension::e2D, multisampled: 0} }.
 - While validating [BindGroupDescriptor] against [BindGroupLayout (unlabeled)]
 - While calling [Device].CreateBindGroup([BindGroupDescriptor]).

findings.consequence: MSAA can be kept: resolve depth in a full-screen pass into a single-sampled depth32float texture

findings.statement: the copyability of a depth aspect is a property of the **format**, not of the canvas texture

findings.consequence: depth readback/copy is possible for depth32float, depth16unorm; slice B MUST use one of those formats for any depth texture that has to leave the pass

recommendation: slice B can keep MSAA: produce the single-sampled depth texture with a full-screen depth pass (shader-written depth and/or an in-shader resolve of the multisampled depth), then let GlobeDepth consume it
